why: In Challenge the challenger is always blue (challengeMatchSetup), so a side effect of the engine is part of every practice match's difficulty. v20 already calibrated drill_mirror's base 70 with that effect included (fixtureOpponents.js comment: identical squads, challenger wins 33%). The v21 layers (skills, Director, laneFrame, layout) changed the side effect (challenge side bias C1 STOP; ladder ATTRIBUTED: skills / layout, see 3a-B_修正規劃.md) and the fixture-vs-fixture strengths (ladder: e.g. mirror>topheavy 71.3 -> 48.2, rotation>balanced 65.2 -> 95.4). The fixture parameters were never re-calibrated for v21. Calibrating them per simulation version is a data-level, v21-only way to give the player a deliberate difficulty ladder whatever the structural side effect is; it does not fix the side effect itself (that needs the shared-engine order fix, deferred by the Owner)

referenceChallenger.R0: a new save: the squad, stats and lineup that the profile store creates for a new game, every hero at mastery Lv.1 (FRESH, as tools/check_player_challenge_slice3.mjs), tactic MOBA_TACTICS[0] (m1, the first listed tactic and the one check_player_challenge_slice3 uses), automatic draft (challengerActions: []). This is the player the v20 drill_mirror calibration was made for (comment: player start average 75)
referenceChallenger.R1: optional (Owner): the same squad at mastery Lv.4 on every hero, a player who has trained a little. Measured in M0 only if the Owner adds it; it would double M0
referenceChallenger.construction: the tool rebuilds the R0 entry snapshot exactly as profileStore._issueEntrySnapshot does after startNewGame("elite") (same careerState: store players / lineup / team, heroProgress FRESH, HERO_ASSIGN, intent entry, reason manual, tactic m1) with two tool-given values: now fixed (1757000000000, so the hash is deterministic) and simulationVersion per arm (the store takes it from the feature flags). Every match is then built like profileStore.startFixtureChallenge: defender = fixtureSnapshot(key, { playerMasteryLevel: 1, simulationVersion }), createDraftResult({ challengerActions: [], pool = CHAMPIONS_100 ids sorted, ... }), createChallengeInstance({ seedSource: seed, kind formal, ... }) and the formal runChallenge with currentSimulationVersion = the arm version

M0.what: baseline ladder: R0 vs each of the five fixtures, challenge.v20 and challenge.v21 (current parameters), challenger win rate with 95% CI per fixture and version, median duration, STANDARD / SWAPPED split
M0.seeds: challenge.c1.baseline 59001-59799 odd (400 seeds; every seed is played against all five fixtures on both versions; the five fixtures share each seed, so fixture differences are paired by seed)
M0.use: descriptive: the numbers the Owner needs to choose the target bands; the v20 column is the shipped ladder, never changed
M0.report: per version and fixture: challenger win rate (unresolved = 0.5) with Wilson 95% CI, the slice3 scoring (strictWin: challengerWin only, unresolved = loss) next to it, unresolved count, median duration, STANDARD / SWAPPED halves on v21 only (challenge.v20 fixes the layout to standard, so its halves are null); per fixture the paired v21 - v20 difference (it includes the layout change); per version the easiest-to-hardest order and the best-minus-worst spread (strictSpread >= 0.20 is the slice3 gradient condition, descriptive); v21 rows say whether the rate is inside the PROPOSED band (descriptive, not a verdict). The report refuses (INSTRUMENT, no ranking, no result file) if any record fails the live check, the error rule says STOP, the R0 hash is not deterministic, or the run has no PIN.json

S1.what: candidate screen on v21 only: per fixture up to three candidate parameter sets around the value M0 implies for the confirmed target band, R0 vs the candidate fixture, 400 seeds each
S1.matches: about 5 fixtures x 3 candidates x 400 = 6,000 (fewer if a fixture is already inside its band in M0: then it gets no candidate)
S1.selection: per fixture: the first listed candidate whose win rate is inside the confirmed band (candidates listed from the smallest change); none => NO_CANDIDATE for that fixture; the ladder order must hold between the selected values (monotone in the confirmed order), otherwise LADDER_NOT_MONOTONE and no selection is proposed; review C1 #m5: the selected set must also have a slice3 spread (strictWin best minus worst) >= 0.20, otherwise SPREAD_TOO_SMALL and no selection is proposed

CF.what: confirmation after the single freeze: R0 vs every calibrated fixture on the frozen v21 by this tool, fresh seeds, the confirmed bands unchanged, plus the slice3 section 3 thresholds applied by this tool on v21 with the slice3 scoring (challengerWin only): the mirror candidate > 0.20 and < 0.85, strictSpread >= 0.20. Review C1 #M4: check_player_challenge_slice3 itself runs on the default flags (mobaTacticalDirectorV21 false, featureFlags.js) and therefore only guards the v20 fixtures; it is still run unchanged and must stay green, but it is not the v21 confirmation
CF.seeds: challenge.c1.confirm 61001-61799 odd (400 seeds, RESERVED, not run)

targets.status: PROPOSAL for the Owner (not confirmed); bands are R0 win rates on challenge.v21 on the slice3 scoring (strictWin: challengerWin only, unresolved = loss), the same scoring as the shipped gate; the report shows the 0.5-scored rate next to it
targets.order: drill_mirror easiest, then drill_balanced, drill_rotation, drill_topheavy, drill_veteran hardest (proposal: the mirror fixture is the documented first-match candidate; veteran's mastery 12 is the documented hard end; the middle order follows M0 unless the Owner fixes it)

bands.drill_mirror: 0.45-0.60 (a real chance on the first match, not a guaranteed win; review C1 #m5: with the slice3 gate N = 16 a true 0.35 would fail its > 0.20 check about 12% of the time and 0.45 about 3%, so the lower bound is 0.45 to avoid adding to the registered flaky gate; inside the gate's < 0.85)

targets.spread: best minus worst >= 0.20 on the slice3 scoring (strictWin), checked on the selected set (the bands alone do not imply it); the slice3 gradient condition, threshold unchanged
targets.note: the bands are internal design targets. Nothing about them may reach the UI: fixtureOpponents.js and the challenge board must not carry strength / rating / tier fields or win-rate / recommended-difficulty wording (check_player_challenge_slice3 section 1)

dependsOnC2: C2 (tools/fixtures/challenge_c2_registration_3aB.json) decides whether one hero / seat or one lineup carries the v21 side effect. If C2 finds a single carrier (a hero kit whose knockout removes most of the effect, or one lineup with a mirror side effect far from the others), the calibration of the fixture that drafts that hero / uses that lineup is listed first and its candidate values are centred on the C2 estimate; if the effect is diffuse, all five fixtures are calibrated the same way

Instead the R0 and five fixture snapshots at moba-sim.v21 equal the v20 ones field by field after removing only simulationVersion and hash; v21 match equivalence then follows by construction (createChallengeInstance takes simulationVersion from the challenger snapshot and rejects a mismatch, runChallenge picks the ruleset from challenge.simulationVersion)
